profile_text.body:
Craft Ventures is a for-profit venture capital firm headquartered in San Francisco, California, according to its website. The material on its site centers on its investing activity rather than on products of its own.

The site highlights a third investment by Craft in Horizon3, backing a $250M Series E at a $2B+ valuation. Craft describes autonomous AI hacking as becoming critical for continuous security validation, and says Horizon3's work is trusted by 7,000+ organizations including four Fortune 10 companies.

No litigation is recorded against Craft Ventures, and its recorded legal exposure is in California.
